status: Unadmitted handling-field proposal; all-outlet common blockage wets the working deck and is a failure

plate.scope: Flat perforated field over structural grid; holes, water, corrosion, deflection and supports not qualified.

ball.scope: Ball-down catalogue rating per unit only; water, point contact, fatigue, fixings, skid and unequal support require proof.

channel.scope: Open common collector with west, middle and east chutes. An all-outlet blockage leaves a central forward spill onto deck.

support.scope: Proposed 25-wide support-grid reservation beneath the sheet; actual span, bracing, bearing, fixtures and induced loads are not designed.

pipeSleeves.scope: Split watertight sleeves initially retain existing pipes; after disconnect and removal, structural flush infill must be installed before any skid can bear or translate across these openings. Actual pipe diameter, collar and reinstatement are not defined.

states.normal: Uncovered south and adjacent side-edge drips reach field and/or chutes; whole roof plus court event remains 3.60375 L/s, not an added roof event.
states.allChutesBlocked: Common collector rises and spills centrally over y5300 front crest onto the +5540 working deck. No directed full-width overflow capture is authored. Stop and retreat is not proved safe: this state FAILS the unattended/common-failure duty.
states.twoBlocked: If both outer chutes are blocked, the middle chute is the proposed remaining path, conditional on actual inlet, common-channel continuity and downstream outlet. No physical full-duty result exists.
states.singleChute: Each chute is a full 3.60375 L/s conservative challenge, including any adjacent roof drips directly intercepted. Actual inlet, roughness, crossfall, turn, debris and downstream backwater remain unproved.

limits: Field steel 2 mm, 150-pitch supports, 40-high rear/side lips and 10-high front edge are authored envelopes, not structural design, flatness or watertight proof. All bolts, seams, joints, brackets and tool/worker sweeps must fit.

Four ball-down units are proposed; three times the 25 kg catalogue value is only a nominal static ceiling, not an adopted payload, factor of safety, wet rating, drop capacity or hoist adequacy. The actual complete module, skid and dynamic actions are unknown.

A 200-diameter open sleeve contains a trial skid ball centre (81.44 mm from the sleeve centre). It must be structurally flush-infilled after the upper pipe is disconnected before the receiver is lowered onto the field.
A nominal ball diameter exceeds a 9 mm hole; point contact stress, local bending, burrs, wet debris and movement require product and physical testing.

The lowered receiver bottom +6360 clears rear lip +6350 by only 10 nominal; attachment, deflection and uncertainty could erase it. The side chutes demand actual supported pipe removal and require continuous protected guards.

The outer chutes clear nominal end-post circles by only 6 mm at each end; brackets, guard projections and tolerances can erase that reservation. At y6150 their top lies between the toe board and midrail, not proof of a complete guarded penetration.
The 600 x600 proxy is an isolated clear rectangle in a hypothetical standing strip; it does not prove reach, escape, access between tower members or safe work under suspended loads.

The outer chutes intercept parts of adjacent side drips at x4450/7550 and must be included in the single event ledger. Ideal weir head excludes losses, splash, wind, common backwater, clogging and freeboard.
